title: Agent Allowlist Framework: binding document
description: What an adopter declares when it puts lists to use. Its keccak256 over the RFC 8785 form is BindingConfig.documentHash

adoption.description: Who adopts and on what authority over the consumer

scopeDocument.description: documentHash of the scope the binding applies in

reuse.description: Whether a decision on this action may be used again. NONE: every use is decided on its own. WHILE_CURRENT: the consumer may rely on a decision again while it is current. ADMISSION: a decision to proceed is recorded per context and subject and honoured afterwards

effect.description: What proceeding and what refusing mean for this action

standing.description: ACTOR: how it is established that a caller may act for a subject

updates.description: How the binding follows changes of its lists and who may amend it

workInProgress.description: What a change of result means for work already admitted, and why each action is declared with the reuse it has

follows.description: latest: every change of the list applies at once. pinned: the binding holds to one state until it is amended

restriction.description: The limit the consumer applies, in the call that carries out the action, when it proceeds under PROCEED_RESTRICTED. Required where that disposition is declared

kind.description: What is limited: cap, count, targets, expiry, or another name the document explains

per.description: What the limit is counted per, such as subject and context

appliedBy.description: Where the limit is applied: the contract and the call that carries out the action
